metric_definitions.cell_sd: Median of measured per-protein/per-line SDs after cell median shifts, within each retained tier
metric_definitions.batch_sd: Median across proteins of SD of mixed-batch means after subtracting observed within-line protein means; same statistic applied to simulations
metric_definitions.missingness: Raw PSM mask for TMT, selected raw quantitative assay mask for DIA, in the fixed accepted cell/protein population
metric_definitions.aggregation: Compare means over twenty independent simulations; every applicable tier must meet its tolerance
metric_definitions.native_design: Cell lines are samples. Two condition sample counts can be unequal or include a zero count at beta=0. Exact source sample-by-batch occupancy retained.
metric_definitions.half_cells_fraction: Descriptive only, outside the gate: fraction of all proteins detected in at least half the native-design cells; observed versus mean and SD over the same twenty replicates.
